name: banded-standing-shoulder-press
instructions:
1. Stand on a band with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the band at shoulder height using a pronated grip (thumbs pointing towards one another).
2. Inhale and press the band overhead by extending the elbow and flexing the shoulder.
3. Slowly lower back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
